ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District and indications as shown on Map No. 16-D
in the area bound by:

       The west line of Illinois Central Railroad (Metra Electric); South Dorchester Avenue; East
       71st Street; a line 455.0 feet west of and parallel to South Dorchester Avenue; a line
       159.0 feet north of and parallel to East 71st Street; the east line of Canadian National
       Illinois Central Railroad (South Shore Line); a line 295.0 feet north of and parallel to East
       71st Street; a line 264.0 feet west of and parallel to South Dorchester Avenue,

to those of a M2-2, Light Industry District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                             Desmon C. Yancy
                                                             Alderman, 5th Ward




Common Address:
7050 S. Dorchester Avenue
